name: Wrapped iTRY
oneLiner: wiTRY is a Brix staking wrapper that accrues yield over iTRY, exposure to a BVI-regulated Turkish-lira money-market fund and local TRY instruments.
collateral: iTRY deposited into the Brix staking wrapper, backed by a BVI-regulated Turkish-lira money-market fund and related TRY cash/liquidity instruments
pegMechanism: wiTRY appreciates against iTRY as fund yield is minted into the staking contract and vests over time; users can unstake through a cooldown or use Fast Redeem for a fee, while final TRY exposure inherits iTRY issuer and local-currency risk

mintAuthority.summary: wiTRY is Brix's yield-bearing staking wrapper over iTRY. The wiTRY wrapper owner and the underlying iTRY token owner are both Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 L2 multisigs (3-of-5 threshold, no modules, no guard) sharing the same 5 signers, confirming issuer-controlled mint authority.

controls.label: wiTRY staking wrapper owner (Brix Safe 3/5)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295016: owner() on wiTRY (0xe346c29b5b60ef870b9724c57ccfbbc631e47dee) returned 0x7ac3bb10225a4ef27134bcf54454d545a1738662. masterCopy() = 0x41675c099f32341bf84bfc5382af534df5c7461a (Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 L2). getOwners() returned 5 signers. getThreshold() = 3. getModulesPaginated returned empty array. guard slot = 0x0 (no guard).

controls.label: iTRY underlying token owner (Brix Safe 3/5)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295016: iTRY token at 0xb492b4afd9658093694cf9452d5c272e8230f3b0; owner() = 0xbdb430adf64ff1c8201c10221ddb846fa62613b6. masterCopy() = 0x41675c099f32341bf84bfc5382af534df5c7461a (Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 L2). getOwners() returned same 5 signers as wiTRY owner, threshold = 3. These Safe contracts share the same signer set confirming unified Brix issuer control.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295016: wiTRY wrapper owner and iTRY token owner are both Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 L2 multisigs (3/5, same 5 signers) confirming issuer-controlled architecture. MegaETH OFT adapter (0x15b271d9012b5820fc42b1c495b4c1e206547de5) owner could not be confirmed — MegaETH public RPCs returned errors — but the Ethereum primary chain is fully verified. MegaETH is a bridged deployment; the Ethereum Safe controls the canonical supply.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: wiTRY uses LayerZero OFT Adapter infrastructure between Ethereum and MegaETH. Brix docs list an Ethereum wiTRY OFT Adapter and a MegaETH wiTRY OFT representation bridged through LayerZero messaging, so the route is external lock/mint rather than MegaETH canonical rollup bridging.
